notes.title: Master the Forge
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers,

Journey deep into the heart of Nangrim and unravel the mysteries that have been tucked away within its ancient tunnels. Introducing, for the very first time, the concepts behind the resource cycle and forging mechanic that promises to challenge both your crafting skills and survival instincts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/77658adc317c18b0cd4b296d8a6ad9628dc8a5c6.jpg[/img]

[h1]From Rust to Relic[/h1]
Whether you stumble upon a rusty pickaxe or embark on a quest to locate the perfect ore, the depths of Nangrim will offer a plethora of materials. Smelt these ores into pristine metal ingots and be prepared to forge them into instruments of unparalleled power. 🪓 

[h1]The Forge's Fervor[/h1]
The essence of forging is not just in the metal, but in the heat. Each material demands a specific fervor; a heat so intense that you may need to venture into the treacherous forests for wood, or dive even deeper into the mountain's belly for coal. ⛏️🔥 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/542829456852ba1b802734c4684663bd144acbfb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Master the Craft[/h1]
But be wary! Tools deteriorate, especially under the punishing work of a dedicated dwarf. As you integrate more and more materials into your forging processes, the complexity of the crafting recipe increases. Not just skill, but artistry and precision are required. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/cccdfa8232a51bbc355bd0e50302fd5e37520e76.jpg[/img]

Forge illustrious hammers, pickaxes, and a myriad of other tools. Hone your forging abilities and imbibe the expertise passed down from generations. ⚒️⛏️

[previewyoutube=t_dJQnEYZwk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Crafting Melody – Hear the Echoes of the Mountain[/h1]
Feel the resonance of the mountain with each hammer blow on the anvil. The metals have their song, their rhythm, and as a master blacksmith, you'll learn to play along. 

The dwarven crafting melody is a symphony that resounds deep within the heart of the mountain, where the art of metallurgy takes on a mystical form. Every clang of the hammer against metal isn't just a mere strike but a note, forming a unique song that speaks to the essence of each item being crafted. As the smith's hammer falls, it taps into the very rhythm of the mountain itself, echoing ancient beats that have pulsed through the earth for aeons. The anvil and hammer serve as instruments that amplify this rhythm, allowing the crafter to tune into each melody and mold the metal in harmony. The result is a piece that isn’t just a tool or weapon, but a manifestation of the mountain's song and the legacy of the ancestral spirits. Each crafted piece, be it a blade, armor, or trinket, carries with it a distinct song, a testament to the skill and spiritual connection of the hands who forged it.

[spoiler]Technically, the number of blows and their intensities at the different anvil positions define the forging melody, which corresponds to a numerical hash. This hash defines the procedural appearance of the forged item (tool, weapon, jewellery, tankard, etc.).  If you change the melody, the shape changes in tandem.[/spoiler]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/3ae862b567f8e14807725282ea4a111b5f9d0908.jpg[/img]

Also, you might unearth crafting techniques from various dwarven clans and perhaps even integrate the wisdom of other races or dark cults.

[h1]The Legend of Haldyr[/h1]
Among the dozens of metals, legends whisper of Haldyr – the most sacred and sturdy of metals. To forge with it, one needs a flame hotter than any conventional furnace can provide. Rumors abound of dragon fires with the potential to melt even Haldyr. Will you be the dwarf to find them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/968cd0ea1ae7b00708617cdde7d3ebb202a84e85.jpg[/img]

[h1]Final Words[/h1]

In the unforgiving realm of Nangrim, challenges abound. Tools and weapons deteriorate, and demand repair. But resources are a rare treasure, demanding effort to extract from the mountain's firm embrace. Your robust arms, while powerful, drain energy, necessitating ample food and brews. But, even brewing beer requires more than mere air and sunlight. 🍺🐝🌞🌬️

Get ready to delve into advanced production chains and cyclical resource systems. As you progress, the complexity will amplify, demanding strategic planning, efficient management, and a keen understanding of the interconnected processes.

Reclaiming the mountain won't be a stroll in the park, but then again, when have dwarves ever backed down from adversity? The mightier the foe, the sharper the axe!

Join us on the development journey of "Return to Nangrim", merge survival with craft, and let destiny guide your hammer. See you in the mines; the tunnels are waiting. ⛏️

notes.title: Environment Update
notes.content:
Rumours have been circulating that the "Return to Nangrim" project has been abandoned, but we want to clarify things and share some news. We are heavily focused on developing the survival and sandbox mechanics, including mining, brewing, crafting, chopping, harvesting, and other nature-related elements. 🏔️⛏️🍻⚒️

We're also working on implementing a dynamic environment, and continuous calendar with moon phases and celestial mechanics. We assure you that the project is actively being developed, and you don't have to worry about its progress.

To give you a glimpse of what we've been working on, we've released a video showcasing the nature around the main mountain. This is part of a case study we conducted earlier, and it highlights the soundscape, dynamic nature, and environment.

[previewyoutube=6KWcW_-Wti8;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know your thoughts!

notes.title: Color Grading Challenge
notes.content:
[h1]New Color Grading Feature[/h1]
The preview branch with the experimental [b]color grading feature[/b] is now available for everyone who is either part of the Players' Guild or owning the demo. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/77271eddd2d9c67d6c5e16918f2076f8aa943a76.png[/img]

[h2]Accessing Preview Branches[/h2]
To access experimental builds on the preview branch on Steam, use the following password: [i]PlayersGuild[/i]

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]
We are looking for the best color grading profiles. Please post your best creations together with a proposed preset name either in the Steam forums or on the Arafinn Discord server and keep the preset numbers around (do not post them). The three best presets (= the most upvotes on Discord) will be included in the next build. Tag us devs in your posts, and we'll collect your submissions in the 🎨[i][url=https://discord.gg/yxzybbg]color-grading-challenge[/url][/i] channel to receive votes from the community.

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 24 - Collect Coins
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

A neat little feature for the greedy dwarfs among you. On your path, you'll be able to 

[h1]COLLECT COINS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/782afb34ac8b3738620e3f6eb12a9f4c86f7d099.png[/img]

You are walking in the dark, only able to see into the distance by squinting your eyes - the inflamed torch which you are carrying around only clearly lights the next few steps. A spark in the distance catches your attention, it could be the fire’s reflection on the wet rocks, but as you get closer you see something with a geometrical form on the ground. Coins, not only one but several! Someone must’ve dropped them one day while rushing away from here. Blessed be the day a dwarf gets a hold of new riches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/9acf2bc24acf8771271e5a42fd1e5b7fd3b06b0c.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats follow on Steam and join our [url=https://discord.gg/RKqppUZZAy]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 23 - Gather resources
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Looks poisonous? Surely will be of good use! Even if you are yet unaware of how certain objects might benefit your progress make sure to

[h1]GATHER RESOURCES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/46c1f32b9ff200d7acf61fad33d5a582654bff2e.png[/img]

Whether to stay warm and sane, to forge weapons to help you fight off enemies or as instruments to find your way through unknown places, you must find resources. Find them all, as no resource is wasted in the hands of a dwarf, since a dwarf knows their value, how to process and make the best use of them. So gather as much as you can - the environment has a lot to offer, but also check closed objects and reveal hidden spots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/36b945b677673a162a8a473eb98e8785a05c4085.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 22 - Spirit Guide
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

When you are lost in the abandoned mountain city of Nangrim or can't find your way back to known terrain in the depth of the mines you can rely on your dwarven ancestry in form of a

[h1]SPIRIT GUIDE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/611f063bfacfc00395313d564db12f316b255ce0.png[/img]

Your presence in Nangrim has awoken benevolent spirits. Sometimes a voice in your head, so subtle you could mistake it with your own thoughts, gives you important hint on how to survive during your explorations. At other times a full-blown spirit appears in front of you as a ghost with a face and a name.
After an exhausting day, of solving mysterious dwarven riddles you rest on the second story of an old outpost tower. In your dreams, a figure appears and warns you about approaching danger. As you snap out of your dream, sure enough, you hear the footsteps of a creature echoing underneath your current hiding spot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/ae90ffef1ddffaa90d77b0ef91feafde53c14c50.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats follow on Steam and join our [url=https://discord.gg/RKqppUZZAy]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 21 - Light torch
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Whether to remember which path you've already uncovered or to have both hands available in the wet darkness of the mountains to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/860210/view/3118154955727919013]craft[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/860210/view/3023585705517268701]read books[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/860210/view/3059611965026593439]take notes[/url], or even for your own well-being and safety, you can

[h1]LIGHT TORCHES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/0679c4c07b700a861aad35bc90e35a5a3e81106a.png[/img]

As you cross the threshold the stone gate slams shut. The darkness surrounds you and your eyes try to adjust, however, every light source is suffocated at that moment. You hesitate at first, but then decide that it is your only choice to take your torch out, and set it alight. Unsure of the danger you might be putting yourself in, as the torchlight will draw great attention and might put you right in the enemy's sight, you set your torch alight. The warm light of the fire not only relieves your eyes from painfully trying to identify something in the dark but also you recognize more torches fixed to the walls. As you enkindle these, you feel your fear ebb and the tiniest spark of hope begins to glow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/3b7f96e71a946ec2487b08c35b6d59a2b51ddc6c.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/RKqppUZZAy]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 20 - Read Books
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

A considerably little feature, but known to be good for the soul once you have some breathing space, and major essential to learning dwarven culture and customs, you will

[h1]READ BOOKS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/84d7340d9ccc35d6b100cf76a002407bb359046c.png[/img]

There isn’t always time to sit and look through all the objects you found while exploring, that’s a fact when trying to survive in a place as hostile as the one you’ve found yourself in. However, these moments do arrive, and it’s always nice to sit by a fire, take out a few of the books you’ve found, and enjoy some literature in peace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/72e9ae05079e90977217e20cc76cc71ce6a75179.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/RKqppUZZAy]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 19 - Solve Puzzles
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

You have mastered the art of crafting, at least as far as constructing that ladder goes, and thanks to your recently acquired ability to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/860210/announcements/detail/3059611965026593440]take notes[/url], you can always go back and grab it. Next up, however, you'll have to use your wits to

[h1]SOLVE PUZZLES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/67aa38da268e45ffaeda56f97a468215607b0559.png[/img]

After all the learning, the exploring, and the discovering of new and grand places, what better way to put this knowledge to use by resolving ancient puzzles to help you find out more about your adventures? Some of them seem almost too easy at a first glance, but then you find out there are different layers of puzzles you have to solve to actually understand them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/8ca43f3abd4ebdc5ef58ba05242586cc6d5b29a4.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/RKqppUZZAy]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 18 - Take Notes
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Navigating your way through the depths of the Nimbor mountains is no easy task. To remember where you left things you will be equipped with the ability to 

[h1]TAKE NOTES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/45efaaed13c21f8c9a438b30fdf29ee302b71da1.png[/img]

You just constructed a ladder to open a door that had its keyhole at an unreachable height. Luckily, you had carefully inspected the last chamber and found a sketch of how to build one such. After some experimenting, you finally constructed one stable enough to carry your admirable dwarven physique. However, now, that the door is open, the ladder has no more use. Deconstructing would return less valuable resources and cost time, and it's too unwieldy to carry along, however, it may be useful in the future. Therefore, you decide it’s better to draw a map in your book. Now you can mark down where you put or left which object, in case you'd need to return for them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/b016528e9055df044f4541418645308f83f11508.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/RKqppUZZAy]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 17 - Learn Runes
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Dead to the most, but still very much alive in the mountain of Nangrim, the dwarven language of Hilduir will be a constant companion. Therefore, you will 

[h1]LEARN RUNES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/e9b6a11cbe39673d48fa8329dcb1e8f357d3b5f1.png[/img]

As you walk up a long staircase you find a strange inscription on one of the steps, it looks familiar but you can’t quite make sense of it right away. You’ve already seen some of these runes, and you know their meaning, but a couple of the others are new. You sit down to concentrate and try to decipher the new runes and to make sense of the whole phrase. It takes some time but you manage to do it. Wait! Is this the clue to the locked door you recently weren't able to open?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/daa6168543b933192919b181871d398c065429f3.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/RKqppUZZAy]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 15 - Crafting
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

All these resources you have gathered, all these items found, it is time to turn them into something more useful by

[h1]CRAFTING[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/f13571cf6470dde8f95281a16b5166e294b8c06d.png[/img]

All those different metals, looking older than you are and all those creatures trying to kill you. Now that you've discovered one of Nangrims forges, you might proof yourself worthy; forge your first weapon with the aid of that parchment you found recently. But no one is born a master: discover the properties of different types of wood and metal and train yourself. Maybe you will be the one forging the next legendary weapon?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/256e4ff7f57b5341eb209d17d4a1285eec3e6cda.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/jQmkuFF]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 14 - Inventory Management
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

On your journey you will come across a variety of objects, tools and resources of your choice. However, space in your inventory is scarce, thus you must wisely do your 

[h1]INVENTORY MANAGEMENT[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/f13571cf6470dde8f95281a16b5166e294b8c06d.png[/img]

Tools, wood, metals, torches, weapons, minerals, notes, letters, books, and more. Countless treasures are awaiting you in the depths of the mountains. There's not enough space in your inventory to keep all of them, so which ones will you choose? If an enemy shows up, which items will you drop to ensure a safe flight? All questions that you must consider and necessitate a thorough inventory check - all while your backpack grows heavier and heavier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/b93c9bd670e6df7a488e919f2265898e2aeb09d2.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/jQmkuFF]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 13 - Combine
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

The ingenious mind of a dwarf knows not only how to craft and mine, but also how to

[h1]COMBINE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/f740e1e1328e6396020330f41d0b34fa7423b312.png[/img]

A dwarf loves nothing more than swinging the hammer to craft a practical tool, or deadly weapon. However, a forge is not always near, and when navigating the cool darkness of the mountain, tools and weapons are of essence. The dwarve's natural gift of craftsmanship and an ingenious mind shall allow you to precede where others have failed and will let you realize how meaningful combining what seemed useless fragments or single resources can be for your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/4c8c957733f7f48848a50f175a0e2513b0876a36.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 10 - Play Instrument
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

When [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/860210/view/3958066754930547447]singing [/url]you will have to admit that a dwarf's voice might be powerful and resounding, however, not the most harmonic. Therefore, the dwarves have long been taught to 

[h1]PLAY INSTRUMENTS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/4c476b44d43ad14973b286ba3b63df114f3e65ae.png[/img]

And a strong voice shall be accompanied by something rhythmic, whether it be the sole drumming of a dwarf‘s fingers on the ax or the play of an instrument. As you endorse in song and play you start remembering more songs. When alone what better way to find some comfort by playing on your newly found instrument, especially if it helps your memory, and who knows what else a dwarf is capable of doing with an instrument.

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 9 - Sing
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Almost as much as drinking and mining a dwarf loves to:

[h1]SING[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/23d7d53f7ab86fd1ef64dd6cbc4ab613c74b2b53.png[/img]

When the spoken word is not enough to express relief, happiness or pride - or when just drunk - a dwarf will turn to song. Whether songs of war or tales of glory, some have been sung for so long even the stone walls remember the lyrics. However, the powerful resounding voice of a dwarf may carry far into the mountain, so beware, and check the alleys and the darker corners, not to make creatures of the dark aware of your presence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/f7cfc9ecf1f7dd645107d67e26b0ffb9755fc1f2.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 8 - Talk
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

More useful than you might expect, an important feature will be:

[h1]TALK[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a923a82976c0c42a06e4e7943e86c0691541c55b.png[/img]

Exploring dark and narrow spaces for a length of time and alone, leaves a trace even in the most sturdy brain. The intense inspection of the environment and constant tension due to possible danger, lets some strange thoughts flourish. Thoughts that - without realizing it - form into words that then unwillingly cross the lips. Before long you might find yourself talking to yourself. It may be to comfort the loneliness but possibly if you listen closely to your own words your brain might have already realized something you haven't yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/86e2f026b573e5592a5816bac897ff4f74f61f6f.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/jQmkuFF]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 7 - Throw stone
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

A fairly weak attack, but possibly your most strategic move might be to:

[h1]THROW STONE[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a48ab725c190b8b5bbef3ce98d371e24d869352f.png[/img]

Your heavy two-handed ax, one of the most terrifying weapons when wielded skillfully diminishes in impressiveness as you compare it to the jaws of the monstrous creature in your path. Even though you are sure about the path you’ve chosen you must admit to yourself that you are not ready to take on this thing. In despair, you turn around, but as you do so a small stone in front of you catches your sight. You pick it up and it feels smooth and cool in your palm. Standing there you consider if the monster reacts to sound and if you might be able to mislead it. Well, giving it a try won’t harm .. unless .. you hit the beast! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/860210/view/2110440927177052310]RUN[/url]! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/41bce9b0bcd958f8c5d4362c5d212d903094968f.png[/img]

For more news, updates, videos, and chats join our [url=https://discord.gg/jQmkuFF]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 6 - Destroy
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Whether you are trying to unveil a hidden object from inside a crate or need to take a barrel apart for firewood. A useful ability will be to:

[h1]DESTROY[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/5038f3d420c626f855af86dd9007a2b120e0fb06.png[/img]

You lift up a wooden box standing in your way and are about to toss it to the side as you realize something jingling on the inside. As you shake the box you recognize the sound as something small and metallic - might be something which could come to good use. In an attempt to break the wooden box you thrust it to the ground but it won't break. Instead of giving it a second try you grab your axe, lift it high and force it down smashing the wooden box. Fragments fly in all directions and you shoulder your axe once more. As you kneel down to closely examine the contents of the wooden box it unveils just what you had been looking for. Your journey may continue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/960e986c23b4c0aae6d4942071228262fdb988ac.png[/img]

For more updates, news, videos and discussions follow our [url=https://discord.gg/aWGXAcr]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 5 - Inflame
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

As you will be wandering in dark cold dungeons you also should be able to:

[h1]INFLAME[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/42bc3caa61a1c49b87ff77e6fb34027662242f07.png[/img]

The room you enter is cold and spacious. There are only rocks and the remains of barrels and crates lying around. It seems you have found what was once a storage room. You are tired, and this place offers the perfect space to get some rest as it is secluded and shielded off against possible enemies. If only it wasn’t for the cold. But with ingenuity, you collect the remains of the barrels and crates and set them alight with your torch. You have kindled a warming and illuminating fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/5d5eec2c9745dea34c21bc2591389cd569009b46.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 4 - Block
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

Last time you've learned that one of your skills is attacking, so logically you also should be able to:

[h1]Block[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/0740da1893c00718e19dc8761a577159ca4f3bd8.png[/img]

You have already heard the grumble of the giant troll as you’ve entered the abandoned jail, now it is time to face him in the mines. Prepared as you are, you hit him first strike, yet his enormous size and power still grants him advantage. But, even the boldest dwarf does not wade into battle without a repertoire of blocking skills, and the longer the battle, the more the odds turn to your side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a9641d1c1235fbac33b37a2a2ab033061c0fcd24.png[/img]

notes.title: Feature Reveal Part 2 - Running
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers, to another Feature Reveal!

As the last Feature Reveal was [i]walking[/i] the logical 'upgrade' to this is:

[h1]RUNNING[/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/959bc4f69a1e781d5f885dba8ae8595c6297a336.png[/img]

You hear a creaking sound coming from behind you. It could be anything, you think - a rat, the wind, or debris that has come off the mountain. But that would be too obvious, and as you turn around, you spot a giant creature with one too many legs crawling in the shadows. Without anything but your own hands to defend yourself, you decide it would be better to run away this time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34704322/a099b06efd6bd2df74f44d02c2790a1749aecb17.png[/img]
